<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuthorityResponse" name="Authority response"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkAndLive" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start preparation in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Visa</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard" name="Apply for or renew the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further Rot-Weiss-Rot Card period is required after the stated x-month interval, and the card was issued.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Visa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visa_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaApplication" name="Begin card application cycle">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visa_Start_To_Competence</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetentRepresentation" name="Determine the competent representation office">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visa_Start_To_Competence</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Competence_To_Contact</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation office in advance about local and additional requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Competence_To_Contact</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Contact_To_DocumentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentSplit" name="Prepare application requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Contact_To_DocumentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Form</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_TravelDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Photo</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Insurance</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Means</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_OtherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_RefusalGrounds</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteVisaForm" name="Complete the visa application form">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Form</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Form_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_VerifyTravelDocument" name="Verify the travel document meets validity, issue-date and blank-page requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_TravelDocument</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelDocument_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain a compliant 35 x 45 mm passport photo">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Photo</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Photo_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain comprehensive travel health insurance for the stay">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Insurance</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Means</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Means_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_OtherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OtherEvidence_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentSplit_To_RefusalGrounds</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentJoin" name="Application requirements prepared">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Form_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelDocument_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Photo_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Means_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OtherEvidence_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_DocumentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" name="Submit the visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_To_Response</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAuthorityResponse" name="Receive the authority response" messageRef="Message_AuthorityResponse">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_To_Response</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Response_To_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:receiveTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialOutcome" name="Authority response">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Response_To_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_To_AdditionalDocuments</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_To_Issued</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_To_Refused</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested by the authority">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_To_AdditionalDocuments</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocuments_To_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" name="Submit the additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocuments_To_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitAdditional_To_FinalResponse</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFinalResponse" name="Receive the authority's decision" messageRef="Message_AuthorityResponse">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitAdditional_To_FinalResponse</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalResponse_To_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:receiveTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalOutcome" name="Final authority decision">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalResponse_To_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Issued</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Refused</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CardIssued" name="Rot-Weiss-Rot Card issued">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_To_Issued</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Issued</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationRefused" name="Application refused">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_To_Refused</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Refused</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Start_To_Competence" sourceRef="Start_VisaApplication" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetentRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Competence_To_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetentRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_To_DocumentSplit" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_VerifyTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentSplit_To_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_VerifyTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidence_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_DocumentJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentJoin_To_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_To_Response" sourceRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAuthorityResponse"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Response_To_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAuthorityResponse" targetRef="Gateway_InitialOutcome"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_To_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents requested" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialOutcome" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_To_Issued" name="Card issued" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialOutcome" targetRef="End_CardIssued"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_To_Refused" name="Application refused" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialOutcome" targetRef="End_ApplicationRefused"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_To_Submit" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAdditional_To_FinalResponse" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalResponse"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalResponse_To_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalResponse" targetRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Issued" name="Card issued" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome" targetRef="End_CardIssued"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalOutcome_To_Refused" name="Application refused" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalOutcome" targetRef="End_ApplicationRefused"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Preparation branches complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visa_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PreparationComplete" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Start_WorkAndLive" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_To_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="End_PreparationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLive">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RepresentationOffice" name="Competent representation office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" targetRef="Participant_RepresentationOffice" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialResponse" name="Authority response" sourceRef="Participant_RepresentationOffice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAuthorityResponse" messageRef="Message_AuthorityResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Participant_RepresentationOffice" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalResponse" name="Authority response" sourceRef="Participant_RepresentationOffice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalResponse" messageRef="Message_AuthorityResponse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfficeContact" name="Request for visa information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfficeInformation" name="Local and additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CardApplication" name="Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuthorityDecision" name="Authority decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_CardCycle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_CardCycle" name="Apply for or renew the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle has resulted in an issued card and the next stated x-month interval is due.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_CardCycle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CardCycle_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CardCycle" name="Begin a card application cycle">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CardStart_To_Type</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa category">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CardStart_To_Type</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Type_To_AC</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Type_To_D</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination" name="Determine the main Schengen destination, comparing length and purpose of stay when time is equal">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Type_To_AC</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Destination_To_Identifiable</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationIdentifiable" name="Can the main destination be determined?">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Destination_To_Identifiable</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identifiable_To_MainDestination</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotIdentifiable_To_FirstEntry</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Select the representation office of the main-destination country">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identifiable_To_MainDestination</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MainDestination_To_DestinationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="Select the representation office of the first-entry country">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotIdentifiable_To_FirstEntry</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstEntry_To_DestinationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Responsible Schengen country identified">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MainDestination_To_DestinationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstEntry_To_DestinationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DestinationMerge_To_ConsularDistrict</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineConsularDistrict" name="Determine the representation office in the consular district of the applicant’s legal residence">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DestinationMerge_To_ConsularDistrict</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConsularDistrict_To_Registration</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RegisteredInDistrict" name="Is the applicant registered in that consular district?">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConsularDistrict_To_Registration</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_To_OfficeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotRegistered_To_Justify</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyConsulate" name="Provide justification for applying to that consulate">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotRegistered_To_Justify</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Justify_To_OfficeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ACOfficeMerge" name="A or C visa representation identified">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_To_OfficeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Justify_To_OfficeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ACOfficeMerge_To_TypeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineDResidence" name="Determine the Type D applicant’s place of residence and centre of interest using available evidence">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Type_To_D</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DResidence_To_DOffice</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectAustrianRepresentation" name="Select the competent Austrian representation for the Type D application under Section 8 of the FPG">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DResidence_To_DOffice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DOffice_To_TypeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TypeMerge" name="Competent representation identified">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ACOfficeMerge_To_TypeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DOffice_To_TypeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TypeMerge_To_BMEIA</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultBMEIAList" name="Consult the BMEIA list for office addresses, contact details, hours and special requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TypeMerge_To_BMEIA</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BMEIA_To_Contact</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for more information" messageRef="Message_OfficeContact">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BMEIA_To_Contact</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Contact_To_Information</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOfficeInformation" name="Receive information about local and additional requirements" messageRef="Message_OfficeInformation">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Contact_To_Information</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Information_To_DocumentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentSplit" name="Prepare required application items">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Information_To_DocumentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocSplit_To_Form</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocSplit_To_TravelDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocSplit_To_Photo</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocSplit_To_Insurance</bpmn:outgoing>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Preparation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Preparation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>

      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Visa</bpmn:incoming>

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CycleStart_To_Competence</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" name="Determine the competent visa authority">
        <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases they may be issued at certain border control posts or, where visa extension is permitted, by state police headquarters. For a Schengen visa, use the representation of the main travel destination. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination based on length and purpose of stay; if no main destination can be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area. For category A and C applications, territorial competence is based on the applicant's legal place of residence in the consular district. A representation office may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally resident but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there. A type D visa must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence, meaning their centre of interest, verifiable by registration forms, residence permit or visa.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CycleStart_To_Competence</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Competence_To_Contact</bpmn:outgoing>

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Form_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelDocument_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" name="Prepare a compliant passport photo">

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Photo_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance" name="Obtain comprehensive travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means">

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Means_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OtherEvidence_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" name="Are additional documents requested?">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequirementsJoin_To_AdditionalDocsDecision</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin" name="Continue application preparation">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitCardApplication" name="Submit the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_To_CycleEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_To_CycleEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CycleStart_To_Competence" sourceRef="Start_CardApplicationCycle" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Competence_To_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_To_RequirementsSplit" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidence_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsJoin_To_AdditionalDocsDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_To_CycleEnd" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Preparation branches complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visa_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PreparationComplete" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Preparation" sourceRef="Start_Plan" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_To_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="End_PreparationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLive">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CompetentAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication" targetRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Organize preparations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Visa</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Accommodation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard" name="Apply for the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application is due after x months.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Visa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visa_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CardApplication" name="Begin Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CardStart_To_DetermineCategory</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineVisaCategory" name="Determine visa category">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CardStart_To_DetermineCategory</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Category_To_TypeDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsTypeD" name="Is it a Type D visa?">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Category_To_TypeDecision</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TypeD_To_AustrianOffice</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotTypeD_To_SchengenOffice</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineAustrianRepresentation" name="Determine the competent Austrian representation">
        <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence, meaning their centre of interest, which may be verified using registration forms, a residence permit or a visa.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TypeD_To_AustrianOffice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AustrianOffice_To_CompetenceJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineSchengenRepresentation" name="Determine the competent Schengen representation">
        <bpmn:documentation>For a Schengen visa, the representation of the country of the main travel destination is responsible. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area. For category A and C applications, territorial competence falls to the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotTypeD_To_SchengenOffice</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SchengenOffice_To_CompetenceJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompetenceJoin" name="Competent representation determined">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AustrianOffice_To_CompetenceJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SchengenOffice_To_CompetenceJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompetenceJoin_To_Contact</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation office in advance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Contact the representation for more information because additional documents may be requested depending on the circumstances. The Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs website lists representation offices, addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements. Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases they may be issued at certain border control posts or, where visa extension is permitted, by state police headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompetenceJoin_To_Contact</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Contact_To_RequirementsSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" name="Prepare application requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Contact_To_RequirementsSplit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Form</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_TravelDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Photo</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Insurance</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Means</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_OtherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_RefusalGrounds</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" name="Complete the visa application form">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Form</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Form_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareTravelDocument" name="Prepare a qualifying travel document">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide a travel document valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, with at least two empty pages and validity extending at least three months beyond the visa duration.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_TravelDocument</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelDocument_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" name="Prepare a compliant passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide a portrait-format passport photo measuring 35 x 45 mm and meeting the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Photo</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Photo_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance" name="Obtain comprehensive travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Insurance</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeansProof" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Means</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Means_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities">
        <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Requirements may vary by location because evidence is adapted to local standards and coordinated with other Schengen representations.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_OtherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OtherEvidence_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_RefusalGrounds</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Application requirements prepared">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Form_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelDocument_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Photo_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Means_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OtherEvidence_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_RequirementsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequirementsJoin_To_AdditionalDocsDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" name="Are additional documents requested?">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequirementsJoin_To_AdditionalDocsDecision</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin" name="Continue application preparation">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitCardApplication" name="Submit the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_To_ApplicationEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_To_ApplicationEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CardStart_To_DetermineCategory" sourceRef="Start_CardApplication" targetRef="Task_DetermineVisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_To_TypeDecision" sourceRef="Task_DetermineVisaCategory" targetRef="Gateway_IsTypeD"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD_To_AustrianOffice" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_IsTypeD" targetRef="Task_DetermineAustrianRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is Type D.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotTypeD_To_SchengenOffice" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_IsTypeD" targetRef="Task_DetermineSchengenRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is not Type D.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AustrianOffice_To_CompetenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_DetermineAustrianRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchengenOffice_To_CompetenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_DetermineSchengenRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompetenceJoin_To_Contact" sourceRef="Gateway_CompetenceJoin" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_To_RequirementsSplit" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeansProof"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainTravelHealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeansProof" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidence_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_To_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsJoin_To_AdditionalDocsDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsYes_To_Prepare" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Additional documents are requested.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsNo_To_Join" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No additional documents are requested.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditional_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocsJoin_To_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_To_ApplicationEnd" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa preparations complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accommodation_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visa_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PreparationComplete" name="Work and living preparations complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Start_Plan" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_To_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_RotWeissRotCard" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="End_PreparationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLive">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkAndLiveInAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CompetentAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCardApplication" targetRef="Participant_CompetentAuthority" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
